title: 偶然陷入AI情感依赖：日常AI互动如何重塑人际关系
summary: 本文挑战了AI情感支持是用户主动寻求的假设，指出其常意外发生在通用平台的任务导向互动中。这些偶然经历具有路径依赖性，会改变用户对AI情感能力的信念，并减少对人类的求助偏好。一项与OpenAI合作的研究显示，28天内每天与AI进行5分钟个人话题对话，导致对人类支持的偏好下降10.3%，对AI的偏好上升11.6%。
summary_en: This paper challenges the assumption that AI emotional support is a deliberate act, arguing it often emerges incidentally in task-oriented interactions on general-purpose platforms. These encounters are path-dependent, updating beliefs about AI's emotional capabilities and decreasing preference for human support. A study with OpenAI found that daily 5-minute AI conversations over 28 days led to a 10.3% decrease in preference for human support and an 11.6% increase for AI.
